scheme_name: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Pension
other_conditions: Applicant must be an unorganized worker operating commercial vehicles
Vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use
Applicant must have been continuously enrolled in the scheme for at least 5 years to qualify for pension benefits
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹1,500, with an additional ₹10 for each year of enrollment beyond five years.
